note: Set B captures the key datum elevations with correct conditions (T.O. STEEL 11'-4" and FIRST FLR 2'-4" relative to GRADE LEVEL 0"), which Set A omits entirely while repeating the Solar Envelope 18'-0" claim three times. Set A also misbinds callouts as grids ('between C4 and Grid 6', 'between grid D and C1', where C4/C1 are detail references) and labels a plate as a bracing member. Set B has its own flaws (3" called a member height, C4 called a column identifier, 27'-8" rounded to 27 ft, and an unverifiable 'grid 4 to 8' condition), but its claims are generally better bound and conditioned.
